Interface SpringCloudConfigClient

@Client(value="${spring.cloud.config.uri:`http://localhost:8888`}", configuration=SpringCloudClientConfiguration.class) @Requires(beans=SpringCloudClientConfiguration.class) public interface SpringCloudConfigClient
A non-blocking HTTP client for Spring Cloud Config Client.

      @Get("/{applicationName}{/profiles}") @Produces(single=true) @Retryable(attempts="${spring.cloud.config.config.retry-count:3}", delay="${spring.cloud.config.config.retry-delay:1s}") org.reactivestreams.Publisher<ConfigServerResponse> readValues(@NonNull String applicationName, @Nullable String profiles)
      Reads an application configuration from Spring Config Server.
      Parameters:
      applicationName - The application name
      profiles - The active profiles
      Returns:
      A Publisher that emits a list of ConfigServerResponse
